name: corru.observer
source: Corru.Observer is a hard sci-fi visual novel, point-and-click adventure about a contractor hired by an intelligence agency to hack into an alien biological computing device dredged up from the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 《Corru.Observer》是一部硬科幻视觉小说，点击式冒险游戏讲述了一名情报机构雇用的承包商入侵从海底挖出的外星生物计算设备的故事。
